request: Analyze GSE198229 for PMID 35482926 (Mitochondrial mutations alter endurance exercise response and determinants in mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk poly-A RNA-seq, STAR + RSEM expected counts (mm10, Gencode M17)

treatment: exercised (8 wk treadmill, every 2nd day, 45 min at 50% max)

final.sample_inclusion: 60 soleus muscle samples: per strain 6 non-exercised + 6 exercised (3 responders + 3 non-responders) (S3.8.1.p1)
final.primary_estimand: effect of 8-wk endurance exercise training on gene expression, exercised vs non-exercised within each strain
final.repeated_measure_unit: none: one sample per mouse per tissue; independent mice
final.paper_method: limma-voom, exercised vs non-exercised within each strain
final.paper_results: Soleus (S1.2.1.p1, S1.2.2.p1, S1.2.3.p1, S1.2.4.p1, S1.2.5.p1): B6 no major differences except modest IFN-gamma signaling up; ND5 strongest transcriptional response (OxPhos and stress-response genes up); ND6 no induction of mitochondrial genes; CO1 only a few glycolytic genes up; ANT1 no change in glycolytic genes. No DEG counts in the main text (Datasets S1-S11 not available here).

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Methods S3.8.1.p3 describe within-strain exercised vs non-exercised limma-voom on RSEM expected counts; S3.8.1.p1 gives the sample design; DA.p1 deposits GSE198229.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are animal IDs (A76, B9, E42, I50); metadata per tissue was split by a prep script and the ID parsed from title (e.g. 'A76 [heart, ANT1-/-]'). Exact match for ANT1/ND5/ND6/CO1 (48/48). The 12 B6 columns are numbers (25-36 soleus, 37-48 heart) while GEO titles are N1..N69; nothing links them, so the B6 samples are excluded and the numeric columns dropped by matrix_column_pattern. The B6 contrast cannot be run (manual_review: needs the submitter number-to-N-ID map).

matrix.reasoning: File name 'expected_counts', ~94% integer values with fractional remainder, max ~3e6, data_processing: STAR --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM + RSEM. These are RSEM expected counts, the input the paper fed to voom. The sibling fpkm file is not used.

design.reasoning: S3.8.1.p3: 'comparing each gene in the exercise-trained vs. the non-exercise-trained group within each strain'. Strain is a stratum: each strain fitted separately as in the paper. Responder/non-responder status (soleus only) splits the exercised arm by outcome; the paper pools both into the exercised group, so it is not a factor. Between-strain comparisons are baseline genotype questions, not the exercise estimand, and are not run.

candidates.reason_rejected: paper fits within strain; per-strain fit reproduces its variance estimate

final.method: limma-voom (R limma::voom + eBayes, library size = column sums)
